verses.gurmukhi: ਅਵਘਟ ਉਤਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਪਤ ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: avaghaT utar sarovar majan karai japat ajapaa jaap anabhai abhiaasee hai ||

en.bdb: Crossing the difficult discipline of the Yogi; a Guru-oriented person bathes himself in the mystical tenth door of the spiritual realm. He dwells in the elixir-like Naam and becomes practitioner of fearless Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਅਕਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: nijhar apaar dhaar barakhaa akaas baas jagamag jot anahadh abinaasee hai ||

en.bdb: He experiences a continuous flow of the celestial nectar in the mystical tenth opening. He experiences light divine and continuous playing of celestial unstruck melody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aatam aves paramaatam praves kai adhiaatam giaan dhiaan ridh sidh nidh dhaasee hai ||

en.bdb: A Guru-oriented person settles in self and gets absorbed in the Lord God. By virtue of his spiritual knowledge all the miraculous powers now become his slaves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਸਲਿਲ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੮॥
verses.translit_en: jeevan mukat jag jeevan jugat jaanee salil kamal gat maiaa mai udhaasee hai ||248||

en.bdb: One, who, in this life has learnt the means of reaching the Lord is liberated while still alive. He remains unaffected by worldly matters (maya), like a lotus flower that lives in water and is not affected by it. (248)
